# Recolx Tap — AI Voice Recorder

> Recolx Tap is an AI voice recorder sold in India. Record meetings, lectures,
> and interviews on the device; the Recolx companion app transcribes with
> GPT-5.2 and structures every recording into a Conclusion, To-Do List, and
> Suggestions. One-time device price with no subscription required for core
> features.

## Key facts

- Product: Recolx Tap AI Voice Recorder (model JYDH-100), brand RECOLX
- Price: ₹12,999 one-time on recolx.co.in; ₹9,999 special price on Amazon.in
  (https://www.amazon.in/dp/B0DYNFTBGS), inclusive of GST
- AI engine: GPT-5.2 transcription and summarization via the Recolx app
- Languages: transcribes in 112 languages
- Templates: 71 built-in Pro summary templates
- Ask Recolx AI: chat with your own recordings, answers pulled from the transcript
- Plans: Starter (free, included with device), Pro ₹1,399/mo or ₹6,899/yr,
  Unlimited ₹2,099/mo or ₹17,399/yr — roughly 30% below Plaud's equivalent
  India plan pricing
- Availability: India, Amazon Prime 2-day delivery, no-cost EMI, GST invoice
- Contact: laveshne19@gmail.com

## Compared to Plaud NotePin

Both pair with a companion app and offer Free/Pro/Unlimited plans. Recolx Tap's
Pro and Unlimited plans cost about 30% less than Plaud's equivalent tiers in
India (Recolx Pro ₹1,399/mo vs Plaud ₹1,999/mo; Recolx Unlimited ₹2,099/mo vs
Plaud ₹2,999/mo).
